questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that when sides AB and DC are produced, they meet at E, and sides AD and BC meet at F, when produced. If ∠ADE = 80° and ∠AED = 50°, then what is the measure of ∠AFB?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ADE = 80° 

∠AED = 50° 

**Concept used:**

In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles are 180° 

Sum of linear pair of angles of is always 180° 

Sum of all 3 interior angles of triangle is 180° 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f2241474a43ab8cd86e7b7125fbfecb8c9e9a150fc9c78c7322e9307e317f05.png] 

∠ADE + ∠ABC = 180° 

⇒ 80° + ∠ABC = 180° 

⇒ ∠ABC = (180° – 80°)

⇒ ∠ABC = 100° 

∠ABC + ∠CBE = 180° [straight line]

⇒ 100° + ∠CBE = 180° 

⇒ ∠CBE = (180° – 100°)

⇒ ∠CBE = 80° 

In ΔAED

⇒ ∠AED + ∠CBE + ∠ECB = 180° 

⇒ 50° + 80° + ∠ECB = 180° 

⇒ 130° + ∠ECB = 180° 

⇒ ∠ECB = (180° – 130°)

⇒ ∠ECB = 50° 

 Now,

⇒ ∠ECB = ∠DCF = 50° (Vertically opposite angles)

and 

∠FDC = 180° - ∠ADC (Linear pair)

∠FDC = 180° - 80° = 100°

∠FDC + ∠DCF + ∠AFB = 180° 

⇒ 100° + 50° + ∠AFB = 180° 

⇒ 150° + ∠AFB = 180° 

⇒ ∠AFB = (180° – 150°)

⇒ ∠AFB = 30° 

**∴ The required value of ∠AFB is 30° **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f2241474a43ab8cd86e7b7125fbfecb8c9e9a150fc9c78c7322e9307e317f05.png] 

From the above diagram,

⇒ ∠ADC + ∠CDF = 180° [ Linear pair of angles]

⇒ 80° + ∠CDF = 180° 

⇒ ∠CDF = 100° 

Now, In ΔAED

⇒ ∠AED + ∠ADE + ∠EAD = 180° 

⇒ 50° + 80° + ∠EAD = 180° 

⇒ ∠EAD = 180° - 130° = 50° 

Now, ∠EAD = ∠DCF = 50° 

In ΔDCF

⇒ ∠CDF + ∠DFC + ∠DCF = 180° 

⇒ 100° + ∠DFC + 50° = 180° 

⇒ ∠DFC = 180° - 150° = 30° 

⇒ ∠DFC = ∠AFB = 30° 

∴ The required value of ∠AFB is 30°

questions.question: A customer wanted to purchase an item marked for Rs. 10000. Shopkeeper offered two types of discounts, 25% flat discount or successive discounts of 14% and 12%. Which is the better offer for the customers and by how much?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

An item purchased by customer = Rs. 10000

First types of discounts = 25%

Second types of discount = successive discounts of 14% and 12%.

**Formula used:**

Single discount on two successive discount = (a + b – ab/100)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Single discount on two successive discount = (a + b – ab/100)

⇒ (14 + 12 – 14 × 12/100)

⇒ (26 – 1.68)

⇒ 24.32%

The best discount = First types of discount – Second types of discount

⇒ (25 – 24.32)% 

⇒ 0.68%

Now,

The better offer for the customers = Rs. (10000 × 0.68/100)

⇒ Rs. 68

**∴ First offer by Rs. 68 **

questions.question: If 2x + 3y + 1 = 0, then what is the value of (8x^{3} + 8 + 27y^{3} - 18xy)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2x + 3y = -1

**Formula used:**

(a + b)^{3} = a^{3} + b^{3} + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

2x + 3y + 1 = 0

⇒ 2x + 3y = -1

Now,

(2x + 3y)^{3} = (2x)^{3} + (3y)^{3} + 3 × 2x × 3y (-1) = -1

⇒ 8x^{3} + 27y^{3} – 18xy = -1

Now,

The value of (8x3 + 8 + 27y3 – 18xy) = (8 – 1)

⇒ 7

**∴ The required value is 7**

QR = 6 cm

**Concept used:**

The ratio of the two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

⇒ 16/25 = AC^{2}/6^{2}

⇒ 25AC^{2} = 36 × 16

⇒ AC = (24/5)

⇒ AC = 4.8 cm

**∴ The required value of AC is 4.8 cm **

questions.question: In a triangle ABC, length of the side AC is 4 cm more than 2 times the length of the side AB. Length of the side BC is 4 cm less than the three times the length of the side AB. If the perimeter of ΔABC is 60 cm, then its area (in cm^{2}) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the side AC is 4 cm more than 2 times the length of the side AB

Length of the side BC is 4 cm less than the three times the length of the side AB.

The perimeter of ΔABC = 60 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef7a9de7e42474b7b485c558313a386fc300bdd23d625dfa64649ecfd722420e.png] 

Let the side of AB be x cm

Then,

Length of the side AC is 4 cm more than 2 times the length of the side AB = (2x + 4) cm

Length of the side BC is 4 cm less than the three times the length of the side AB. = (3x – 4) cm

Perimeter of ΔABC = 60 cm

⇒ (x + 2x + 4 + 3x – 4) = 60

⇒ 6x = 60

⇒ x = 10 cm

Now,

Side of AB = x = 10 cm

Side of AC = (2x + 4) = (2 × 10 + 4) = 24 cm

Side of BC = (3x – 4) = (3 × 10 – 4) = 26 cm

We know that 10, 24, and 26 is a triplet, 

⇒ We can say that the given triangle is a Right angle triangle.

Now,

⇒ Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height

Area of triangle = (1/2 × 10 × 24)

⇒ (5 × 24) 

⇒ 120 cm^{2}

**∴ The required area is 120** **cm2 **

questions.question: The average of 23 numbers is 51. The average of first 12 numbers is 49 and the average of last 12 numbers is 54. If the twelfth number is removed, then the average of the remaining numbers (correct to two decimal places) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 23 numbers = 51

The average of first 12 numbers = 49

The average of last 12 numbers = 54

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The sum of 23 numbers = (23 × 51) = 1173

The sum of first 12 numbers = (12 × 49) = 588

The sum of last 12 numbers = (12 × 54) = 648

Now,

The twelfth number = [(588 + 648) – 1173]

⇒ (1236 – 1173)

⇒ 63

The 12^{th} number = 63

Now, If the twelfth number is removed,

The sum of remaining numbers = (1173 – 63) = 1110

The average of remaining number = (1110/22)

⇒ 50.45

**∴ The required average number is 50.45**

questions.question: A can complete a work in \(11\frac{1}{2}\) days. B is 25% more efficient than A and C is 50% as efficient as B. Working together A, B and C will complete the same work
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to complete a work by A = \(11\frac{1}{2}\) days = 23/2 days

B is 25% more efficient than A = (25/100) = 1/4

Efficiency of A = 4 days

Efficiency of B = (4 + 1) = 5 days

C is 50% efficient than B = (50/100) = 1/2

Efficiency of C = (5/2) = 2.5 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Total work = (23/2 × 4) = 46 days

Total time taken by A, B and C together = [46/(4 + 5 + 2.5)] days

⇒ (46/11.5) days

⇒ 4 days

**∴ The required time is 4 days**

questions.question: The area of a table top in the shape of an equilateral triangle is 9√3 cm^{2}. What is the length (in cm ) of each side of the table?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of a table top in the shape of an equilateral triangle is 9√3 cm^{2}

**Formula used:**

Area of equilateral triangle = √3a^{2}/4 

**Calculation:**

According to the question

The area of a table top in the shape of an equilateral triangle is 9√3 cm^{2}

⇒ √3a^{2}/4 = 9√3 

⇒ a^{2} = (4 × 9)

⇒ a^{2} = 36

⇒ a = 6 cm

**∴ The length of each side of the table is 6 cm**

questions.question: The vertices of a Δ ABC lie on a circle with centre O. AO is produced to meet the circle at the point P. D is a point on BC such that AD ⊥ BC. If ∠B = 68° and ∠C = 52°, then the measure of ∠DAP is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AD ⊥ BC

∠B = 68° 

∠C = 52° 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5095d80f27201a31a5dab09d3c67a306c38c8455f7508213fd5f5e4cf1eb3efb.png] 

Join O to B where point O is the circum centre of the triangle.

⇒ ∠BOA = 2∠BCA

⇒ 2 × 52° 

⇒ 104° 

In ΔBOA

⇒ OB = OA [radius of the circle]

⇒ ∠OBA = ∠OAB

⇒ ∠AOB + ∠OAB + ∠OBA = 180° 

⇒ 2∠OAB = (180° – 104°)

⇒ 2∠OAB = 76° 

⇒ ∠OAB = (76/2)

⇒ ∠OAB = 38° 

In ΔABD

⇒ ∠ABD + ∠BDA + ∠DAB = 180° 

⇒ ∠DAB = (180° – 90° – 68°)

⇒ ∠DAB = 22° 

Now,

∠DAP = ∠BAO – ∠BAD 

⇒ ∠DAP = (38° – 22°)

⇒ ∠DAP = 16° 

**So, the required value is 16° **

questions.question: A train covers 450 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 5 km/h more, it would have taken 1 hour less to cover the same distance. How much time will it take to cover 315 km at its usual speed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let the actual speed be x km/h and the actual time taken be t hr.

Distance = (X × Y)/(X - Y) × [Time Difference]

⇒ 450 = {x × (x + 5)}/(x + 5 - x) × [t + 1 - t]

⇒ 450 = [x(x + 5)]/5

⇒ 2250 = x × (x + 5)

⇒ 2250 = 45 × (45 + 5)

On comparing x = 45 km/h

Actual time taken = 315/45 = 7 hr

**Traditional method:**

**Given:**

If the speed had been 5 km/h more, the train covered a distance = 450 km

If speed had been 1 hour less, the train covered a same distance

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of train be x km

According to the question

⇒ 450/x – 450/x + 5 = 1

⇒ 450(x + 5) – 450x = x^{2} + 5x

⇒ 450x + 2250 – 450x = x^{2} + 5x

⇒ x^{2} + 5x – 2250 = 0

⇒ x^{2} + 50x – 45x - 2250 = 0

⇒ x(x + 50) – 45(x + 50) = 0

⇒ (x – 45)(x + 50) = 0

⇒ x = – 50, 45

⇒ x = 45 km/h

Now,

Time taken to cover the distance of 315 km = (315/45)

⇒ 7 h

**∴ The required time is 7 h**

questions.question: If \(x+\frac{1}{x}=7\), then \(x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}\)is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

\(x+\frac{1}{x}=7\)

**Formula used:**

(a + b)^{2} = a^{2} + b^{2} + 2ab

**Calculation:**

According to the question

\(x+\frac{1}{x}=7\)

squaring both sides, we get

⇒ (x)^{2} + (1/x)^{2} + 2 × x × 1/x = (7)^{2}

⇒ x^{2} + 1/x^{2} + 2 = 49

⇒ x^{2} + 1/x^{2} = (49 – 2)

⇒ x^{2} + 1/x^{2} = 47

**∴ The required value is 47**
